responsibility: Declares XCOFF-specific debug-output policies, macros, and entry points used by dbxout.c and target code when emitting AIX/XCOFF debugging information. The header customizes generic stabs handling for XCOFF storage classes, predefined fundamental type numbers, static block delimiters, register-parameter encoding, continuation rules, and main-source/include-file conventions, and it exports the XCOFF line/block/function hooks and per-compilation-unit section-name globals implemented in xcoffout.c.
same_name_distinction: Defines XCOFF-specific stabs policy macros, storage-class/type-number customizations, shared globals, and function prototypes that tailor dbxout.c behavior for AIX/XCOFF. Unlike xcoffout.c, it does not emit line, block, or function records itself; it is the configuration/interface layer for that implementation.
